items.stem: Which Korean sentence means "The orange is more expensive than the apple"? Words: 오렌지 = orange, 사과 = apple, 비싸요 = is expensive, 보다 = than, 더 = more, 제일 = the most.
Write this sentence in Korean: "I am bigger than you." Use the polite style. Words: 저 = I (polite), 너 = you, 커요 = is big, 보다 = than, 더 = more, 는/은 = topic marker.
Which Korean sentence means "The apple is the tastiest"? Words: 사과 = apple, 맛있어요 = is tasty, 보다 = than, 더 = more, 제일 = the most.

One sentence below breaks a rule of Korean comparisons. Which one? Words: 그 = he, 형 = older brother, 지수 = Jisu, 저 = I, 친구 = friend, 남동생 = younger brother, 빨라요 = is fast, 커요 = is big, 예뻐요 = is pretty, 덜 = less.
Write this sentence in Korean: "My younger brother is the fastest." Use the polite style. Words: 남동생 = younger brother, 빨라요 = is fast, 제일 = the most, 가장 = the most, 는/은 = topic marker.
